description: This Dart source file defines the AppDatabase class, which manages an SQLite database for a Flutter expense tracking application. It handles database initialization, table creation for categories, transactions, budgets, and meta information, as well as seeding initial data such as default categories, budgets, and sample transactions on first run.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for initializing, opening, and managing the application's SQLite database, including schema creation and data seeding.

methods.name: AppDatabase.instance
methods.description: Static singleton instance of the database handler.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Getter that asynchronously returns the database instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _initDb
methods.description: Initializes the database, creating the database file and setting up onCreate and onOpen hooks.

methods.name: _onCreate
methods.description: Creates database tables and initial seed data during first database creation.

methods.name: _ensureSeed
methods.description: Populates the database with default data and sample transactions if it's the first run.
